Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “paternal grandmother” (father’s mother) as the father’s grandmother, shifting from George II’s mother to George II’s grandmother. This led to incorrectly identifying Countess Palatine Christiane Henriette of Zweibrücken-Birkenfeld (George I’s mother, i.e., Princess Augusta’s great-grandmother) instead of the correct paternal grandmother, Princess Augusta (Auguste) of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen (George II’s mother).
